description: TikTok trending hashtags, viral content, and the Top Ads competitor library — synced to a local store that tells you what to create and what account to build.

novel_features.name: Niche report
novel_features.description: Get a one-command brief for a niche: trending hashtags, their top creators, and representative videos ranked together.

novel_features.name: Trend velocity
novel_features.description: Measure which tracked hashtags are accelerating by diffing popularity curves across syncs.

novel_features.name: Competitor sweep
novel_features.description: Summarize a competitor's top-performing content and which trending hashtags they ride.

novel_features.name: New since last sync
novel_features.description: Show hashtags and top content that are newly trending since your last sync.

novel_features.name: Watch / alerts
novel_features.description: Track hashtags and report which crossed a popularity threshold since the last snapshot.

novel_features.name: Related hashtags
novel_features.description: Surface similar or co-rising hashtags to one you specify, using stored industries and shared creators.

novel_features.name: Viral / underserved score
novel_features.description: Rank hashtags and content by opportunity = high popularity + low publish count. Find what's rising but not yet saturated — the signal for what to create before everyone piles in.

novel_features.name: Trending/viral content discovery
novel_features.description: One ranked feed of trending/viral content pulled from the Top Ads library, representative videos in hashtag detail, and top creators' work — across all three in one list.

novel_features.name: Content & account decision brief
novel_features.description: Given a niche, output a concrete recommendation: which hashtags to ride, what content formats are working, where the saturation gaps are, how competitors are positioned, and what account angle is still open.
